text: Election of the Chair for the Property Standards Committee - North York Panel under Municipal Code Chapter 27, Council Procedures, Appendix A2, for the appointed Term of Office ending October 26, 2026, and until a successor is appointed.
The Property Standards Committee, North York Panel: 1. Elected Monica Purdy as the Panel Chair for a term of office expiring October 26, 2026, and until a successor is elected.
